reviews.reviewText: The paper was 80% conceptual and slightly tough. Past files were not helpful; preparation should rely on short lectures and handouts. MCQs were mostly scenario-based (e.g., medical choices based on culture vs religion). Important topics included Deviance, Primary and Secondary groups, Social change, Social conflict, and Social groups. There was a specific question about how Eid-ul-Fitr and Eid-ul-Adha shape Pakistani society. Questions also covered Traditional and Pre-modern societies, the Pakistan court system, and the 4 types of religion. Theories and Perspectives are very important.
